note: Free places to list a local business, most important first. Costs and rules change: each entry names its source.

sites.name: Google Business Profile
sites.why: Puts you on Google Search and Google Maps, where most local customers look first.
sites.fits: Businesses that meet customers in person or travel to them
sites.tip: Use the exact same name, phone and web address everywhere else on this list.
sites.quote: Yes, creating a Business Profile and listing your business on Google is free.

sites.name: Apple Business
sites.why: Your place card in Apple Maps and Siri on every iPhone. Apple Business replaced Apple Business Connect in April 2026.
sites.fits: Businesses with a location or a service area
sites.tip: Add your logo, photos and hours so the place card looks complete.

sites.name: Bing Places
sites.why: Shows you on Bing and Microsoft's apps and assistants.
sites.tip: Import your Google profile: it fills the form in and can verify you at the same time.

sites.name: Facebook Page
sites.cost: Free to open and run (ads and boosted posts cost money)
sites.why: Neighbors check it for photos, hours and messages, and local groups link to it.
sites.tip: Turn on messaging and add your booking link to the button.

sites.name: Nextdoor Business Page
sites.why: Neighbors recommend local services here, and your page collects those recommendations.
sites.tip: Promote from the Business Page, not your personal account: Nextdoor allows only occasional informal offers from personal accounts.

sites.name: Yelp
sites.why: Many apps and car dashboards read Yelp's listings.
sites.tip: Claim it and keep it accurate, but don't ask anyone for a Yelp review: Yelp asks businesses not to.

sites.name: Better Business Bureau
sites.cost: Check bbb.org for current terms. Accreditation is optional and paid.
sites.why: Some homeowners check the BBB before they hire.
sites.tip: Request a business profile; you don't need to pay for accreditation to be listed.

sites.name: Thumbtack
sites.cost: Free profile; you pay when you take on leads
sites.why: People book home, event, lesson and wellness pros there.
sites.tip: Set a weekly budget before you turn on leads, and fill in your profile first.
